race.comment: EXCELLUNA (8) has been very good in her two runs this prep despite drawing wide gates on each occasion. Raced three and four wide but dug deep to get up for third last start over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Will enjoy an economical run this time from the inside stall. Looks the one to beat. PRIORY PARK (7) is back after a 24-week break and has been gelded. Showed ability in his maiden campaign including a win at the only attempt at today's trip. Three recent trials should have him right up to the mark. AGAINST THE LAW (2) returns from a 16-week lay-off. Raced well in town last prep so this is a relatively soft first-up assignment. Recent trial winner who looks poised for a bright return. AEGIPAN (10) loves the 1000m trip, his latest to back when close up at Queanbeyan under 61kgs. Nicely weighted and a good chance to add to his six victories at the trip. MRS FLANDERS (6) led all the way to win consecutive races over today's journey at Moruya in August. Must be considered.
